Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produc

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
items.summary: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports knowledge source in criteria
items.summary: Criteria questions can now use knowledge sources to help evaluate customer interactions. This allows organizations to ground evaluation criteria in approved knowledge content, policies, or guidance so quality checks can better reflect expected handling standards. This preview capability is scoped to case and on-demand evaluations.GA date: January CY2027Preview date: September CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Inactivate quality evaluation records
items.summary: Quality managers can now inactivate evaluation records that should no longer contribute to scoring or reporting. Inactive evaluations are preserved for traceability but excluded from overall score calculations and analytics. This helps teams correct reporting outcomes when evaluations were created in error, used the wrong criteria, were duplicates, or should otherwise be removed from active quality results.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Support Not Applicable answer option for quality evaluation criteria
items.summary: Criteria questions now support a Not Applicable answer option. When a question is marked as not applicable, it is excluded from scoring instead of negatively affecting the evaluation score. This helps ensure evaluations remain accurate when a specific criterion does not apply to the case, interaction, or business scenario being reviewed.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Detailed quality evaluation score breakdown
items.summary: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level. Users can see how the final evaluation score was calculated, including how individual question outcomes contribute to section scores and the overall score. This improves transparency, helps quality teams validate results, and makes it easier to identify areas for coaching, calibration, and process improvement.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
items.summary: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.GA date: October CY2026
